outlook.statement: The Company continues to explore options for setting up a new business/project and is in the process of appointing a consultant for this purpose.

The Company's near-term outlook remains contingent on identifying and commencing a new business activity. The Board will keep Members updated as this process progresses. The principal opportunity is the identification and commencement of a viable new business line, for which the process of engaging a consultant is ongoing. The principal threat remains prolonged absence of operating revenue, which continues to erode the Company's net worth through recurring administrative costs.
Consent of Board of Directors is accorded to appoint a consultant for setting a new project.

Operational Risk: risk remaining after determining financing and systematic risk, includes risks resulting from breakdowns in internal procedures, people and systems
